newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Vandals desecrate Jewish cemetery in Slovakia.
newsitem.headline: Vandals desecrate Jewish cemetery in Slovakia.

text.p: Vandals desecrated a Jewish cemetery in Nove Zamky, southern Slovakia, overturning and damaging more than 160 tombstones, the independent daily Sme reported on Friday.
One of the tombstones was smeared with a Nazi swastika the paper said, adding that the damage was estimated at more than 1.2 million Slovak crowns ($38,000).
The paper said the incident happened some time last week, but gave no further details.
Neither the local police nor the Jewish community was immediately available for comment.
